scope: edited stills from one real local auction captured by tools/demo-capture/capture.mjs; time cuts state real elapsed time from the capture manifest

scenes.title: No bid is ever opened. The price is still proven.
scenes.caption:
Other designs prove the price by opening the bid amounts at the close.
DarkCall never opens them. On the right: an auction already settled on public Zcash testnet.

scenes.title: 1 · Create an auction
scenes.caption: 3 identical units · reserve 20 · deposit budget 100 zatoshi · bidding closes in 2 minutes.

scenes.title: 2 · Seal a bid
scenes.caption:
The bidder's client proves in zero knowledge that the bid commitment matches 3 secret shares,
one per operator. Operators check and sign. (Demo: the local helper sees the typed bid.)

scenes.title: Four sealed tickets
scenes.caption: Bids 77, 61, 43 and 21 were typed for this demo. Nothing here shows or publishes them.
Bidding stays open until its real deadline.

scenes.title: 3 · Close and fund
scenes.caption: The three operators sign the closed book. Clearing waits until every ticket is funded.

scenes.title: Fund on Zcash
scenes.caption: Each ticket gets a real shielded deposit on public Zcash testnet, into a 2-of-3 FROST escrow.
Deposits confirm on testnet; operators decrypt them and re-verify the same proofs and shares.

scenes.title: Deposits locked, same book
scenes.caption: 4 deposits · 4 bid proofs + 12 share pairs re-verified · 12 receipts · book signed again over the same root.

scenes.title: 4 · Clear by MPC
scenes.caption:
Three operators compute on secret shares (REP3) and jointly prove the result (coNoir).
No one reconstructs the bids.

scenes.title: One public price: 21
scenes.caption:
Proof verified in under 10 seconds. 3 of 3 units sold. The price is the highest losing bid;
who placed it, and every winner's bid, stay hidden.

scenes.title: 5 · Only your result
scenes.caption: Ticket 01 opens only its own verified outcome: won, refund 79.

scenes.title: 6 · Settle on Zcash
scenes.caption: One shielded transaction will pay the seller and refund all four bidders.

Six Halo2 output-binding proofs, the settlement proof, 2-of-3 FROST signing,
broadcast to testnet, 2 confirmations, six wallet scans and the public check.

scenes.title: Settled and publicly verified
scenes.caption: Every output is bound to the proven result. A public verifier replays it with no secrets.

scenes.title: Who learned what
scenes.caption:
Everyone: the price and a shielded transaction. Each bidder: only their own result.
Operators: winners and refunds, never the bid list.

scenes.title: Your shielded receipt
scenes.caption: Ticket 01 decrypts its memo with its own viewing key: won, 79 zatoshi refunded.

scenes.title: A losing ticket
scenes.caption: Ticket 04 decrypts its own memo: lost, the full 100 zatoshi refunded.

scenes.title: Try to cheat
scenes.caption: Flip one byte of the receipt proof: the fixed verifier rejects it before the key is read.

scenes.title: What this prototype assumes
scenes.body:
Bid secrecy: at most one semi-honest corrupt operator (REP3).
Custody: 2-of-3 FROST; two colluding signers can move funds.
Operators learn winners and refunds. The price is the highest losing bid.
Demo: all parties on one machine; the local helper sees typed bids.
Public Zcash testnet through one trusted lightwalletd provider; testnet coins only.

scenes.title: Verify it yourself
scenes.body:
scripts/docker_verify.sh
Builds every pinned tool from committed source in a clean Linux container,
verifies every committed settlement and rejects a tampered proof.
